items.brief: WSJ full-page ad attacks SEC innovation exemption for tokenized securities venues
items.why: Shows pushback against regulatory exemptions enabling tokenized securities trading

items.brief: Polygon and Solana team up to bring stablecoin payments to banks
items.why: Links stablecoin activity with banking and payment infrastructure for tokenization

items.brief: Bank of England opens consultation on tokenized collateral for clearing
items.why: Proposed guidance would require tokenized collateral to meet liquidity and risk tests

items.brief: Chainlink adds weekend pricing for tokenized assets, with Aave as launch partner
items.why: Addresses pricing gaps when traditional markets close for tokenized assets

items.brief: Aviva adds tokenized share class to Sterling Liquidity Fund on XRP Ledger
items.why: Tokenized fund share class backed by a £50 million commitment

items.brief: Coinbase adds Ripple's RLUSD stablecoin across retail, exchange and Prime
items.why: Stablecoin listing with 1:1 USD conversion on multiple networks
Post-trade infrastructure aims to create a path for tokenized securities adoption

items.brief: Moody's assigns investment-grade ratings to Ripple's RLUSD stablecoin
items.why: Credit ratings citing reserve asset quality for a tokenized stablecoin

items.brief: Robinhood's Tenev warns tokenization uncertainty deters serious assets in US
items.why: Says tokenized equities need more than a temporary SEC exemption
